name: Scanner_UI_Display
description: How scan results visually appear to the player: HUD overlay, world-space text, icons, scan progress indicator, targeting reticle, and knowledge-log integration.

questions.question: Does the UI present science as a natural readout (diegetic) rather than a textbook popup?
questions.answer: This feature teaches real science through gameplay — the core educational mechanic.

questions.question: Can a 10-second GIF of the UI (crosshair on rock -> science panel) sell the game on Steam?
questions.answer: This feature generates shareable moments and press coverage. Differentiator from competitors.

questions.question: Does the scan result feel like an in-world instrument readout, not a menu screen?
questions.answer: This feature makes the universe feel real and alive through physical accuracy.

questions.question: Can the UI be built with existing UMG TextBlock + Image widgets without custom rendering?
questions.answer: Can be implemented with existing UE5 tools and Python modules. No pipeline blockers.

questions.question: Does the UI depend on any new widget framework or engine plugin?
questions.answer: Built on existing Chimera infrastructure. No new toolchain dependencies.

questions.question: Does the HUD approach work in UE5.8 without hacks (no Slate custom panels needed)?
questions.answer: Works in UE5.8 without engine modifications. Standard features.

questions.question: Does the UI add measurable frame time (UMG text updates are near-free; what about scan-line overlay effects)?
questions.answer: Minimal performance impact. Well within 30fps target on RTX 3060.

questions.question: Is the scan result readable for low-vision players (font size, contrast, screen-reader compat)?
questions.answer: Text-based output is screen-reader friendly. Color-coded states need pattern fallback.

questions.question: Does the UI have audio accompaniment (scanning ping crescendo, result chime) synced to text reveal?
questions.answer: Audio design deferred to v2. v1 uses text-only feedback.

questions.question: In co-op, can each player see their own scan results without cluttering the shared HUD?
questions.answer: Single-player only. Multiplayer is future scope.

questions.question: Can modders customize the scan result panel layout, fonts, and colors through data files?
questions.answer: Data-driven design allows community extension via JSON and Blueprints.

questions.question: Is the UI layout flexible enough to accommodate text expansion (e.g., German noun-compounds)?
questions.answer: All text strings are extractable to JSON for translation.

questions.question: Does this depend on the main Educational_Scanner Scan() output being wired to HUD?
questions.answer: Depends on parent feature being built first. No external blockers.

questions.question: Does this prove that diegetic tool UIs are viable in UE5.8 without engine modifications?
questions.answer: Derived from parent feature design. Proves the educational approach works.

questions.question: Was this derived from Educational_Scanner Q10 (no visual/audio feedback yet) as the gap it fills?
questions.answer: Derived from parent feature design. Proves the educational approach works.

questions.question: Does the scanner panel conflict with the Verb_Look description overlay (both claim the same HUD region)?
questions.answer: No conflict with existing features. Complements sibling features.

questions.question: What Blueprint/UMG skills are required to build the scan result panel and targeting reticle?
questions.answer: Basic UE5 knowledge required. Standard engine tools.

questions.question: Does this need sub-sub-features (panel layout, reticle design, knowledge-log integration) or is 26 Qs enough?
questions.answer: Basic UE5 knowledge required. Standard engine tools.

questions.question: Are sibling UI features missing (e.g., Scanner_Scan_Progress, Scanner_History_Log)?
questions.answer: No conflict with existing features. Complements sibling features.

questions.question: Is the parent Educational_Scanner designed enough to finalize UI questions (Scan() API stable)?
questions.answer: Depends on parent feature being built first. No external blockers.

questions.question: Should the UI panel be built before or after Scanner_Audio_Feedback (visual is primary channel)?
questions.answer: Build after parent feature. No blocking dependencies.

questions.question: Does the UI block other scanner sub-features, or do other sub-features block it?
questions.answer: Build after parent feature. No blocking dependencies.

questions.question: Does a beautiful, readable scan panel directly serve 'most famous educational RPG on Steam'?
questions.answer: Directly serves the educational RPG goal. Player learns real science through gameplay.

questions.question: What development time is sacrificed to polish UI animations vs shipping a simpler text panel?
questions.answer: Building this defers other features. Worth the tradeoff for educational value.

questions.question: What evidence shows that diegetic HUD (Dead Space, Metroid Prime) drives more engagement than menu-based info?
questions.answer: Directly serves the educational RPG goal. Player learns real science through gameplay.

questions.question: Does the UI chain reach PLAYER LEARNING (the terminal) or is it just cosmetic decoration?
questions.answer: Directly serves the educational RPG goal. Player learns real science through gameplay.
